Generate strange attractor.

Source: R/attractor_generic.R
attractor_generic.Rd

Generate strange attractor.

Usage

attractor_generic(
  a,
  n,
  x0 = 1,
  y0 = 1,
  dims = c(600, 600),
  progress = (n >= 1e+05),
  n_discretize = 1e+06,
  qs = 0.05,
  parallel_orbit = default_parallel_orbit(),
  discretize = TRUE
)

Arguments

a

Numeric vector that contains the coefficients for computing the attractor

n

Number of points to generate

x0

Initial value for x

y0

Initial value for y

dims

Dimensions of resulting matrix, only used if discretize == TRUE

progress

Ignored; retained for backward compatibility

n_discretize

Ignored; the range is set from the first 1e6 points. Retained for backward compatibility.

qs

Quantile cutoff: a single number in [0, 0.5). The range of each axis is set at the qs and 1 - qs percentiles.

parallel_orbit

Number of independent orbit trajectories that run in parallel (one per thread by default). Use 1 for the serial orbit. The attractor looks the same either way, but the counts differ in detail, and for a given number of trajectories the result is deterministic.

discretize

If TRUE discretizes to a matrix with dimensions dims, else returns a data frame with one row for every data point

Value

if discretize == TRUE a matrix with dimensions dims, else a data frame with columns x and y, and n rows.
